assumptions: No rear trailing truck. Two powered pivots carry all main-body weight in base cases.
Leading truck supports its own estimated mass; half swing-arm weight at each pin. No resolved leading suspension/load sharing.
Catalog engine dry mass only; other component weights are CAD material proxies or explicit allowances. No measured weights.
Static level track. Truck body reaction applied at truck centre. Truck self-weight moment determines the two axle reactions.
Average wheel load assumes lateral symmetry; actual equipment offsets, track twist, braking and roll can unload individual wheels.
Uniform long-component loads are a beam idealization; actual brackets/support points remain to be designed.
Fuel and hydraulic tanks are weight/location reservations only, without fitted tank CAD.

Nonzero leading-share cases assume an equivalent upward force and pitch couple at anchor2600 to place the resultant at truck centre1525. That load-capable attachment is not designed; these are boundary-condition sensitivities.
Low/high budgets are not probability bounds. Rear/front-heavy cases are adverse longitudinal distributions within this assumed ledger.
2× static bending values are a sensitivity only, not a selected design dynamic factor.
